verdict.rationale: Rev AI is a speech-to-text API platform with a dashboard, so an in-product AI assistant is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only transcription and NLP API features (summarization, sentiment) and an MCP server for external tools like Cursor. None of these is a built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
